text: Rockstar built Red Dead Redemption 2 in between. It came out in 2018.
GTA 5 never stopped selling: over two hundred thirty million copies.
And Rockstar delayed GTA 6 twice, officially to reach the quality players expect.
Rockstar said it would have no long-term effect on development.
Was it worth the wait? Comment yes or no.
And subscribe for more GTA 6, the phenomenon of 2026!
